systems.name: Compute Stack
systems.design_note: Adds a flat base token rate on top of the hardware curves. Tier 1 is 0 because today's bedroom baseline (1M/prompt) is entirely the starter laptop, which stays a hardware row during the compatibility phase; leaving tier 1 at zero keeps every bedroom number exactly as it is. Each higher tier is worth 40% of the machine its chapter is staked with (custom_desktop 5M -> 2M, gpu_rack 50M -> 20M, compute_cluster 500M -> 200M), so the stack is a noticeable bonus but hardware remains the main throughput source until Phase 6 consolidates the rows.

systems.name: Cooling Loop
systems.design_note: Tier values are the bedroom, garage, office and warehouse rows of dwelling_costs.json, so a migrated save keeps the room's numbers. Heat-state thresholds are ratios of heat_capacity and are untouched.

systems.name: Power Bus
systems.design_note: Absorbs the dwelling hardware-slot responsibility: the values are the bedroom, garage, office and warehouse floor plans. power_headroom is deliberately not modelled yet.

systems.name: Workflow Backplane
systems.design_note: Supported pipeline stages. Replaces job_scaling.board.supported_stages as the baseline; perk, upgrade and meta slot bonuses stay additive on top.

systems.name: Control Rack
systems.design_note: Saved workflow capacity. Replaces BoardSystem.DEFAULT_WORKFLOW_CAPACITY as the baseline; perk, upgrade and meta workflow bonuses stay additive on top.
